taskpack.goal: Implement the approved P2-06R, P2-07A-R, and P2-07B-R contracts from the verified cleanup-recovery source while preserving strict live isolation and deterministic, provider-free verification.
taskpack.integration_policy: verified integration baseline followed by operator review; never merge to main, push, activate a candidate release, execute P2-08, or call a live provider

contract.live_isolation_policy: all public live launch paths require present source mounts, current repository identity, privileged isolation evidence, and complete namespace-denial evidence at the final launch boundary
contract.historical_replay_policy: historical replay remains private, receipt-bound, digest-bound, and unavailable to live launch callers
contract.lifecycle_policy: every provider invocation is registered before launch, bound to one sandbox, terminal exactly once, consumed exactly once, and sealed into the complete invocation manifest
contract.calibration_policy: calibration is deterministic, provider-free, equal-input, all-outcome, cleanup-aware, and makes no benchmark superiority claim
contract.promotion_policy: P2-08, live calibration, candidate release promotion, main-branch merge, and push remain forbidden

write_scope_cardinality_policy.exception_scope_rule: production and schema paths exact; test and fixture directory scopes allowed
write_scope_cardinality_policy.exception_verification: focused task verification plus complete runtime suite

success_criteria: All three modes consume one immutable protocol and reach the common evaluator, finalizer, and cleanup path.
All provider lifecycle records are sandbox-bound, terminal, uniquely consumed, and complete.
Live launch revalidates source identity and cannot disable namespace evidence through a public API.
Deterministic calibration retains equal-input, usage, isolation, cleanup, outcome, replay, and projection evidence.
Gate validators recompute relations and current authorization without executing P2-08 or a live provider.
The complete runtime suite passes on the final integration baseline.

policy.semantic_authority: approved Phase 2 v4 contract plus verified cleanup recovery and this bounded remainder contract
policy.repo_map_policy: refresh the committed handoff once, then consume only bounded symbol and test context
policy.trace_policy: compact task evidence plus one milestone integration report
policy.merge_policy: integration baseline only; operator controls source merge

tasks.objective: Refresh the bounded Phase 2 repository handoff for execution modes, lifecycle authority, calibration, and gate controllers on the verified cleanup-recovery source.
tasks.goal_alignment: Gives the remaining L2 tasks current symbol and test context without a full repository reread.
acceptance_criteria: The handoff binds recovery_source_commit and supersedes cleanup-only map content.
It names exact symbols and focused tests for P2-06R through P2-07B-R.
It records the source-identity TOCTOU and public namespace-evidence downgrade findings without proposing unrelated architecture.
tasks.stop_condition: Stop if the handoff cannot remain bounded and evidence-linked.

tasks.objective: Audit and repair the three execution-mode adapters under one immutable protocol, strict live isolation, standalone sanitized workspaces, and complete lifecycle registry authority.
tasks.goal_alignment: Completes the common execution layer and closes the independent launch-boundary review findings.
acceptance_criteria: All modes consume equal protocol facts, environment, model policy, budgets, and operator limits.
Author, attempt, and candidate workspaces use independent standalone Git object stores.
Every provider lifecycle is registered, sandbox-bound, terminal, and included exactly once in the sealed invocation manifest.
Missing, stale, extra, unconsumed, or non-terminal registrations fail before evaluation.
Every mode reaches the common evaluator, result finalizer, and cleanup receipt path.
The final live launch boundary revalidates each mutable source identity after admission checks and before exec.
No public live API can disable required namespace-denial evidence; any probe-only helper remains private and unreachable from mode adapters.
Ordinary tests never launch a live provider.
tasks.stop_condition: Stop if modes receive unequal inputs, provider-visible state can modify controller authority, or launch safety requires a new external privilege model.

tasks.objective: Re-run deterministic L1 and bounded L2 calibration across all modes and retain equal-input, usage, isolation, cleanup, bundle, replay, and projection evidence.
tasks.goal_alignment: Proves the repaired harness before any separately governed candidate promotion.
acceptance_criteria: All three modes execute the same deterministic protocol family and environment contract.
Counted lifecycle and token usage coverage are 100 percent without duplicate stable-request cost.
Canary denial, sealed result preservation, and cleanup receipt completion are proven.
Every required terminal outcome remains visible after projection rebuild.
Calibration output makes no benchmark superiority claim.
tasks.stop_condition: Stop if deterministic evidence requires a live provider or is presented as scored evidence.

tasks.objective: Audit and repair deterministic Phase 2 gate controllers and relation validators without executing promotion or any live provider call.
tasks.goal_alignment: Leaves a reviewed executable candidate for the separately approved P2-08 promotion taskpack.
acceptance_criteria: Gate validators recompute Git and evidence relations rather than trusting schema-valid strings.
P2-09 cannot call a provider without current epoch-bound operator authorization.
The candidate runtime can materialize the separately governed controller-only promotion blueprint.
This recovery run does not execute P2-08, install a candidate release, merge the source branch to main, or push.
The complete runtime suite passes on the final integration baseline.
tasks.stop_condition: Stop if a gate can pass without recomputation or a live call can bypass current authorization.
